manufacturer_revision.description: Explicit source-published manufacturer revision. Project digests, ingestion revisions, retrieval dates and catalog snapshots are distinct identities and cannot populate this field. Missing/null is unknown.

derived_fields.description: Provenance for calculated product values keyed by canonical field path. A field absent here is not thereby asserted to be published; source refs establish published facts.

unsupported_capabilities.description: Explicit source-backed unsupported capabilities. Missing positive entries do not assert absence. Engineering use requires the same record review as positive capabilities.

port_ids.description: Exact capability participants. Omission is unknown; global capability presence does not associate an unrelated port.

frequency_hz.description: Port-specific published frequency support; no AC input/output or global frequency inheritance is implied.

isolated.description: Explicit path-local galvanic isolation assertion. Omission is unknown.

category.description: Optional classification metadata; omission does not exclude a canonical record from engineering selection.

verification_status.description: Recorded status only. Engineering authority additionally requires a valid content-bound engineering verification history whose latest event matches the exact record. The loader withholds history-less or stale verified claims; schema validity alone does not establish authority.

isolation_relationships.description: Product-local separation properties. These are not conductive relationships and do not assert installed-system bonding or grounding.

electrical.description: Null preserves unknown electrical data, matching the canonical loader and TypeScript contract; it never means zero or unsupported.

power_consumption_w.description: Unconditional published electrical power consumption only. Material voltage, state, or measurement conditions belong in qualified_values. Missing is unknown.

usable_depth_of_discharge_fraction.description: Published usable depth of discharge expressed as a fraction, distinct from a calculated usable capacity.

maximum_series_voltage_v.description: Published maximum series string voltage; it does not by itself assert a permitted unit count.

usable_capacity_ah.description: Product usable Ah, either directly published or calculated from published nominal Ah and usable DoD. Calculated entries require root derived_fields provenance. Not design-usable system energy.

allowed_series_count.description: Permitted count of identical battery units in series per string, directly published or derived from a clean voltage-class relationship with root derived_fields provenance. This is not a recommendation, total battery count, arbitrary bank size, or parallel-string count.

allowed_parallel_count.description: Manufacturer-permitted number of identical series strings connected in parallel; this is not a total battery count, per-string unit count, or arbitrary bank size.

dimensions_mm.description: Physical body dimensions in the component-local frame, in millimeters. x = width, y = depth, z = height. These are not installed/world extents, wall distance, service clearance, or an implied mounting orientation. Installed envelopes are derived from a chosen permitted orientation.

service_clearances_mm.description: Clearances are separate from physical body dimensions. Local face keys x_min/x_max/y_min/y_max/z_min/z_max are component-local; null or missing means unresolved, not zero. Legacy front/rear/left/right/top/bottom keys remain accepted for compatibility but do not define world axes.

orientation_constraint.description: Legacy strings remain compatible. The structured form distinguishes unrestricted from unknown and may restrict local mounting faces or stable orientation IDs. Unknown is never permission.

interaction_endpoints.description: Stable logical non-power interaction boundaries. Endpoint presence does not assert protocol compatibility, interoperability, installed relationships, information availability, or runtime state.

physical_connectors.description: Stable product-local physical connector or socket instances. Missing means unknown or unmodeled.

protection.description: Currently supported protection applications are intentionally bounded; this vocabulary is not exhaustive of all future protection contexts.

application.description: external_circuit describes protection of modeled external circuitry; internal_device describes manufacturer-described protection belonging to the device's own internal behavior. Neither value claims to exhaustively classify every future protection context.

measurement.description: Currently supported electrical measurement quantities are intentionally bounded; this does not assert runtime readings or exhaustively classify every future measurement context.

engineering_verification_history.description: Append-only explicit human verification events. Operator labels are unauthenticated trusted-local labels. Hashes bind exact content and origin, not authenticated identity; changed content requires a new explicit action.

engineering_profile.description: Versioned source facts for PV, capacity, AC, assembly, battery, instrumentation and unreviewed source-specification consumers. Missing members remain unknown. Presence grants no review or verification authority. Historical records are not migrated.
